title: 👁️ Step 1: Observe (Problem Samjho)
sawal: Question aakhir mang kya raha hai? Kya tum ise aasan bhasha me 1 line me kisi ko samjha sakte ho?
action: Question ko dhyan se dekho: Input me kya mila hai, aur Answer (Output) kis form me wapas mang raha hai.
trap: Question bina poora padhe turant code likhne ki jaldi karna.

title: ✍️ Step 2: Manual Solve (Haath Se Solve Karo)
sawal: Agar computer nahi hota aur tumhe pen-paper pe 4 numbers diye jaate, to tumhara dimag ise haath se kaise solve karta?
action: Ek chhota 4-numbers ka example lo aur khud aam insaan ki tarah step-by-step calculate karke answer nikalo.
trap: Pehle se koi formula ya code sochna — pehle basic simple tareeqe se socho.

title: 🏷️ Step 3: Naam Do (Variables & Loop)
sawal: Paper pe solve karte waqt kaunsa kaam baar-baar hua? Aur pichhla konsa number dimag me yaad rakhna pada?
action: Jo kaam baar-baar hua wo 'Loop' banega, aur jo information yaad rakhni padi wo 'Variable' banegi.
trap: Bina soche 2-3 loop laga dena jisse variables ka matlab hi samajh na aaye.

title: 🔨 Step 4: Sabse Seedha Tareeka (Brute Force)
sawal: Sabse simple aur seedha tareeka kya hai jisme saari possibilities check ho jayein? Kitna time lagega?
action: Sabse basic approach ki time complexity socho (jaise O(n²)). Agar input bada hai to kya ye limit (10⁸ operations) cross karega?
trap: Pehle hi attempt me sabse fast solution sochne ke chakkar me blank ho jana.

title: 🔍 Step 5: Faltu Kaam Dhoondo (Waste Bottleneck)
sawal: Simple tareeqe me kaunsa kaam faltu me baar-baar ho raha hai jo pure code ko slow kar raha hai?
action: Pata lagao: kya tum wahi search dobara kar rahe ho, ya wahi jodd (sum) baar-baar calculate kar rahe ho?
trap: Bina ye samjhe ki purana code kahan slow tha, seedha koi naya algorithm lagane lagna.

title: 🧰 Step 6: Sahi Tool Chuno (Data Structure / Pattern)
sawal: Us faltu kaam ko khatam karne ke liye sabse best Data Structure ya Technique kaunsi hai?
action: Waste-Tool table se matching tool chuno: jaise baar-baar search ke liye HashMap, range sum ke liye Prefix Sum.
trap: Andha-dhundh koi bhi Data Structure lagana jiska problem ke logic se koi lena-dena na ho.

title: 🧪 Step 7: Chhote Example Pe Check Karo (Dry Run)
sawal: Naya tareeka kya mushkil cases pe bhi sahi chalega? (Jaise khali array, 1 number, ya negative numbers?)
action: Paper pe ek chhota table banao aur 3-4 steps haath se chalakar check karo ki answer sahi aa raha hai ya nahi.
trap: Bina dry-run kiye code submit kar dena aur Wrong Answer aane par panic hona.

title: 💻 Step 8: Ab Bina Dare Code Likho
sawal: Logic crystal clear ho gaya? Ab line-by-line clean code likho aur boundaries check karo.
action: Pehle base cases / safety check likho, phir main loop, aur end me result return karo.
trap: Boundary index (jaise i < n ya left <= right) me galti karna ya array bounds se bahar nikal jana.
